name: Communication
description: Clarity, fluency, articulation, vocabulary, structure, and verbal persuasion under constraints.

dimensions.name: Clarity
dimensions.description: Precision of phrasing, absence of vagueness, immediate intelligibility.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Crystal clear, unambiguous, precise terminology, zero cognitive burden on listener.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Generally clear, minor ambiguity or slight circuitous phrasing.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Vague in places, listener must guess intended meaning.

dimensions.name: Fluency & Cadence
dimensions.description: Smooth vocal delivery, minimal filler words (like, basically, you know), natural pauses.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Zero filler words, deliberate rhythmic pauses, 130-160 WPM cadence.
rubricCriteria.70-89: 1-2 filler words, slight hesitation, good general pacing.
rubricCriteria.50-69: 3-5 filler words, awkward pauses, rushed or dragging tempo.
rubricCriteria.0-49: 6+ filler words, persistent vocal stalling, severe cadence disruption.

dimensions.name: Logical Structure
dimensions.description: Executive hook, clear thesis, 2-3 distinct supporting arguments, firm conclusion.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Impeccable architecture (Pyramid Principle), logical transitions, tight conclusion.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Clear beginning, middle, and end, but transitions are abrupt.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Meandering path, main point delayed or buried in details.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Total stream-of-consciousness, rambling, no discernible structure.

dimensions.name: Conciseness & High Signal
dimensions.description: Maximum information density per word, zero fluff, tight time limit adherence.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Surgical density; every single sentence advances the thesis.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Trim with minor repetition or redundant adjectives.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Excessive padding, repeated points, over-explains simple concepts.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Bloated, repetitive, fails to complete within time constraint.

dimensions.name: Improvisation & Composure
dimensions.description: Ability to think on feet, handle sudden constraints or hostile interruptions calmly.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Composed under sudden curveballs, pivots seamlessly without stalling.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Brief hesitation before recovering strong posture and argument.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Visibly rattled, loses train of thought for >5 seconds.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Freezes, becomes defensive or concedes point inadvertently.
